## Problem

What's missing, or what's currently awkward? What are you trying to do
that the app doesn't support well today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see instead.

## Scope check

- [ ] This doesn't require the client to become authoritative for XP,
      ranking, or any other reward-bearing value (see the README's
      [Trust Boundaries](../../README.md#trust-boundaries)).
- [ ] This fits the feature-first architecture (new logic belongs in a
      feature's `domain/data/presentation` layers, not scattered across
      shared code).

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you didn't propose them.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing.
